_comment: Decision 37 follow-up: C-1 popup restyled to the app's Dialog pattern (ModelPickerPopup / LocalModelsSection), named after the plan; B-2 new-limit state lightened. Before = round 1 After (runs/spend-after), After = feat/specialists-plans-ui at the popup fix.
title: Plans — plan settings popup and the new-limit box, redone

steps.path: A plan waiting for approval, after pressing the gear
steps.headline: Plan settings is now built like the app's other popups, and its title names the plan.
steps.changed: Same header, close button, spacing and rows as the Model & Effort popup. Under "Plan settings" it names the plan. Each step is one row, with the step on the left and its model on the right; "Default model" or "Your choice" sits under the step's name.
steps.notice: It looks like part of the app, and the model names are no longer cut off. The inside-the-card version is gone.

steps.path: A plan that reached its limit, after pressing Continue
steps.headline: Pressing Continue at the limit now shows just an amount box, Continue and a small close button.
steps.changed: "New limit $ [box] Cancel Continue" becomes "$ [box] Continue ×". Escape also closes it.
steps.notice: Fewer words and buttons. The row still says which limit was reached.

steps.path: Plan settings with a limit turned on
steps.headline: Turning on a limit opens the amount box and the low-limit warning inside the popup.
steps.changed: "Set a limit" with its switch, then "$ [amount]", then the warning when the amount is below what the plan usually costs.
steps.notice: The same warning you approved last round, now in the popup.
